field_notes.vswr: Taken from the AccelTex sheet (<1.5:1, max 2.0). Hubbell lists Voltage Ratio <2.5.
field_notes.weight: Taken from the AccelTex sheet, which prints 2.5 lb (0.68 kg). Those units do not convert (2.5 lb is about 1.13 kg). Recorded as printed. Not on the Hubbell SPEC.
field_notes.included_parts: AccelTex sheet says the articulating wall/pole mount is included. Hubbell lists the installation type without the word included.
field_notes.bands: 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz. Hubbell notes outdoor/connectorized 6 GHz use in the U.S. may require pending FCC equipment-approval updates.
field_notes.connector: Hubbell Connector Type is N Plug. AccelTex says N-Style. Primary value uses Hubbell.
field_notes.image_url: Hubbell SPEC product photo is shared with ATS-03411.
field_notes.dimension_image_url: Dimension drawing is the same AccelTex image used for ATS-03411. It shows six pigtails and a 600 × 600 × 40 mm outline.

internal_notes.maintainer: High-density patch mining batch. Compatible AP list is internal-only and must never render in the UI. Hubbell SPEC lists Fortinet FAP-432F twice; stored once.
